result.stdout:
FogellAI Agent

Usage:
  fogellai-agent
  fogellai-agent --version
  fogellai-agent --dry-run
  fogellai-agent --probe-work
  fogellai-agent --once
  fogellai-agent --bootstrap
  fogellai-agent -connect -url https://portal.example -tenant appnavi -client-id fogcli_x -secret-env FOGELLAI_AGENT_SECRET
  fogellai-agent --role Reviewer --allow-reviewer-pr-actions

By default the agent loads the connected portal configuration from the local settings file.
Use -connect with -url, -tenant, -client-id and -secret-env/-secret to connect from parameters and overwrite the saved portal registration after a successful connection.
Use --dry-run to validate registration and bootstrap checks without changing work items.
Use --probe-work to check claimable work without claiming, tagging, testing, or updating work items.
Use --work-item-types, --incoming-state, --required-tags, --outgoing-state, --outgoing-tags and --developer-parallelism-limit to tune workflow routing.
Reviewer agents are comment-only unless --allow-reviewer-pr-actions is set or the portal enables that reviewer policy.
